overall_reason: Violet carries every role: a lavender-pink-blue wash under the card, four violet text shades for heading, figure, labels and link, gradient bars with violet glows and purple shadows, with no neutral ink and no source.

score.reason: T-COLOUR-SOURCE finds no source for the violet family, T-PALETTE-ROLES finds four violet text shades and no ink, and T-ACCENT-DOSAGE finds the large figure and the heading in the accent.

findings.title: Do not use violet/lavender in the page's own palette
findings.where: the whole activity card, 1440 and 375, tiles/1440-00.png and bg-1440.png
findings.evidence: The area palette lists #e8e2fb at 4.4% and #b59fde bars; text is #7567a6, #7964b1, #7e5caf and #9887b8 (hue about 293). Shadows are rgba(178,146,212,0.42) 0 0 10px on 5 bars and rgba(146,132,197,0.18) 0 0 24px on the card. The sweep's gradient and glow hits land here.
findings.before: A lavender wash, violet text, violet bars and violet glows.
findings.after: An accent sampled from the client's own imagery or brand (Sample, Converge, Justify), on neutral paper.
findings.why: With no source, the palette reads as the generator's default violet, not this product's colour.

findings.title: The palette converges to a few roles
findings.where: 'Weekly activity', '124', 'tasks completed', '18 more than last week', 'View report', 1440
findings.evidence: The palette table lists 0 neutral text levels and 4 violet text shades: #7567a6 on the heading, #7964b1 on two elements, #7e5caf and #9887b8.
findings.before: Every text element is a slightly different violet.
findings.after: A neutral ink for heading and figures, one grey for secondary text, and the accent only on 'View report'.
findings.why: With no ink role, nothing on the card is quieter or louder by colour, and the link does not read as a link.

findings.title: Display type is set in ink
findings.evidence: The figure is the largest type on the card and is set in the violet #7964b1 family.
findings.after: The figure in ink; the accent kept for the action.
findings.why: Display type in the accent spends the accent on emphasis that size already gives.

findings.title: Do not use gradients in chart marks
findings.where: the five bars M to F, 1440
findings.evidence: The palette table lists gradient stops on the bars (#cba4df into a deeper violet) and a coloured zero-offset glow on each bar.
findings.after: Flat bars in one colour, with the current day in a stronger step.
findings.why: Gradients and glows on data marks add colour that carries no data.

not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page renders light; the stylesheet has a dark class theme that the capture did not render, so dark mode is not verified
brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours were available for T-COLOUR-SOURCE; sources were traced from the composition itself
contrast and focus: owned by the sweep (A11-001, A11-003) and not restated here
